elements.name: Admin
elements.description: An administrative user with elevated privileges for managing the system.

elements.name: User
elements.description: A human user interacting with the multiuser web application.

elements.name: Export scenario
elements.description: User selects export format, system serializes the current graph state, and delivers it for download.

elements.name: Graph edit scenario
elements.description: User proposes a change, the system validates it through the Apply-Gate, and applies the change if valid.

elements.name: Live update scenario
elements.description: System detects a change, validates it, and pushes the update to all connected clients in real-time.

elements.name: Login scenario
elements.description: User enters credentials, system validates, grants access, and redirects to the graph editor.

elements.name: Authentication Flow
elements.description: Handles user login, session management, and access control.

elements.name: Export Flow
elements.description: Handles graph state serialization and delivery for export.

elements.name: Graph Editing Flow
elements.description: Manages collaborative graph editing and validation through the Apply-Gate.

elements.name: Live Update Flow
elements.description: Pushes real-time updates to all connected clients.

elements.name: Apply Graph Change
elements.description: Validates and applies changes to the governed graph through the Apply-Gate.

elements.name: Authenticate User
elements.description: Validates user credentials and establishes a secure session.

elements.name: Export audit requirement
elements.description: Each export must be logged with user ID, timestamp, and graph version.

elements.name: Export authorization requirement
elements.description: Only authenticated users may trigger export.

elements.name: Export format requirement
elements.description: Exported graph must be a valid Format-E v2 slice.

elements.name: Live export requirement
elements.description: Export must reflect the latest graph state at time of request.

elements.name: Export notification requirement
elements.description: User must receive a confirmation email with download link.

elements.name: Export performance requirement
elements.description: Export must complete within 2 seconds for graphs up to 10k nodes.

elements.name: Export security requirement
elements.description: Exported artifacts must be encrypted at rest.

elements.name: Export storage requirement
elements.description: Exported artifacts must be retained for 30 days.

elements.name: Export validation requirement
elements.description: Exported graph must pass basic structural validation.

elements.name: Multiuser Web Application
elements.description: A governed system enabling collaborative graph editing with real-time updates and export capabilities.

elements.name: Web-App
elements.description: Multiuser-fähige Web-App aus dem graphcode harness: Nutzer melden sich an, autorieren gemeinsam einen governten Systemgraphen über das Apply-Gate, sehen Live-Updates und exportieren den Stand.

elements.name: Test export authorization

elements.name: Test export format

elements.name: Test live export
elements.description: Verify that exported graph reflects the latest state.

elements.name: Test export notification
elements.description: Verify that users receive confirmation emails with download links.

elements.name: Test export performance
elements.description: Verify that export completes within 2 seconds.

elements.name: Test export security

elements.name: Test export storage

elements.name: Verify export audit requirement

elements.name: Export governed system graph
elements.description: User requests a snapshot of the live governed graph and receives it as a downloadable artifact.

elements.name: User exports the current graph state
elements.description: Users can export the governed graph in a specified format for offline analysis or documentation.

elements.name: User edits the governed graph collaboratively
elements.description: Authenticated users propose changes to the graph, which are validated and applied through the Apply-Gate.

elements.name: User sees live updates to the graph
elements.description: Users receive real-time notifications and visual updates when changes are applied to the graph.

elements.name: User logs in to access the governed graph
elements.description: A user provides credentials to authenticate and gain access to the collaborative graph editing environment.
